```{r}
# Load Libraries
library(readr)
```

```{r}
# Read in data
cities <- read.csv("cities.csv")
outlook <- read.csv("outlook_meanings.csv")
forecast <- read.csv("weather_forecasts.csv")
```

```{r}
sum(is.na(cities))      
sum(is.na(outlook))     
sum(is.na(forecast))    
```

```{r}
# 2. Check for duplicate rows
sum(duplicated(cities))     
sum(duplicated(outlook))    
sum(duplicated(forecast))   
```


```{r}
head(cities)      
head(outlook)     
head(forecast)     
```

```{r}
# For cities dataset
str(cities)         
names(cities)       

# For outlook dataset
str(outlook)
names(outlook)

# For forecast dataset
str(forecast)
names(forecast)

```
